title: Aarya
hook: How does Aarya Season 3 end? The Sooraj reckoning, the surrender for her children, and Sampat's betrayal, explained.

sections.heading: The reckoning with Sooraj
sections.body: Season 3 brings the long feud with Sooraj Raizada to its violent end. The season's first half closes on Sooraj's death, after he lures Aarya to the place where his wife Nandini is buried, holding Aarya's friend Maya hostage to draw her out. To protect her son Apu, Maya tells Sooraj that it was Aarya who killed Nandini, and Aarya plays along with the story rather than expose the lie. The confrontation ends with Sooraj dead. Although the killing leaves Aarya shaken and upset, she steels herself, decides to move forward, and turns her attention to protecting the consignment her enemies are circling.

sections.heading: Choosing her children over the empire
sections.body: The heart of the finale is Aarya's decision to walk away from the criminal world entirely. She concludes that ending her involvement in the drug business is the only way to get her children back, who have pulled away from her under the constant danger her work brings into their lives. It echoes a path her late husband Tej once planned, leaving the trade and the country, with Aarya following the same idea three years later. The choice reframes her whole arc, a woman who fought to inherit and defend an empire now ready to surrender it for the sake of her family.

sections.heading: Confession and surrender
sections.body: Aarya's exit is not clean. To save Maya from prison, she confesses her own role in the deaths tied to Sooraj and Nandini, taking the weight of the crimes onto herself. Truths about the past keep surfacing, including her involvement in earlier deaths within the family, which forces upheaval at home. She moves to surrender to the authorities, offering to turn informant for the officer Khan as the price of getting out and getting her children to safety. The plan is meant to be her way free of the cycle of violence that has consumed three seasons of her life.

sections.heading: Sampat's fatal betrayal
sections.body: The surrender becomes a trap. Once word of Aarya's plan to inform spreads, Sampat takes matters into his own hands. In the closing moments he confronts her, reminding her of the fate reserved for informants and traitors, and shoots her in the heart, multiple gunshots ending the scene. Based on the way the finale stages the shooting, Aarya dies from these wounds, branded a traitor at the very moment she tried to choose her children over the business. A crucial thread is left dangling: exactly who tipped Sampat off about her secret surrender plan is never answered.

final_image: Aarya shot in the heart by Sampat, branded a traitor and informant at the very moment she tried to leave the business for her children.

lingering_questions.q: Does Aarya die at the end of Season 3?
lingering_questions.a: Based on the finale, yes. Sampat confronts her over her plan to turn informant, reminds her of the fate of traitors, and shoots her in the heart, the wounds presented as fatal.

lingering_questions.q: Who told Sampat about Aarya's surrender plan?
lingering_questions.a: The series leaves this unanswered. It is never revealed who informed Sampat that Aarya intended to surrender and become an informant, making the betrayal a deliberate loose end.
